votes.evidence_summary: HTTP 200 responses with code 1804 correctly rejecting data with undefined field 'color'
votes.rationale: Both upsert and insert operations correctly rejected with code 1804 and error 'has pass more field without dynamic schema' because the test data included field 'color' which is not defined in the collection schema (schema only has 'id' and 'vector' fields); this is correct API behavior, not a defect
